aliases.name: AM Vikhr
aliases.note: Avtomat Malogabaritnyj 'Vikhr' — 'small-sized automatic rifle', the original designation.

massEmpty.sourceNote: TsNIITochMash's own exhibition placard, legible in this entry's hero photograph: 'Масса с магазином без патронов, кг: 2,1' — mass with an empty magazine fitted, 2.1 kg.

length.sourceNote: TsNIITochMash's own exhibition placard, legible in this entry's hero photograph: 'Габаритные размеры, мм: 640/395' — 640 mm with the stock extended, 395 mm folded.

barrelLength.sourceNote: Wikipedia's infobox figure, no inline citation of its own; matched by military-today.com.

cyclicRate.sourceNote: Wikipedia states a published range of 700-900 rounds per minute with no inline citation; midpoint recorded here.

capacity.sourceNote: TsNIITochMash's own exhibition placard, legible in this entry's hero photograph: 'Емкость магазина, патронов: 20, 10' — 20- and 10-round magazines, shared with the AS Val and VSS Vintorez.

images.alt: A compact black submachine-gun-like carbine with a folded top-mounted stock and a curved magazine, lying on a wooden table beside two Russian-language exhibition placards.
images.caption: An SR-3, buttstock folded, photographed beside TsNIITochMash's own exhibition placard giving its mass, dimensions and magazine capacities.
